prototype.implementation: SHA-256 digests cover each stored content scalar with type and length framing, excluding created_at. Typed calculations stream exact canonical bytes into a digest; unchanged entries skip final bindings and compact-string assembly. Decimal conversion and validation still occur. Posting digests are computed during validation. Fresh rows use prepared writes. No preparation is moved outside the timer and no schema, values, transaction policy or DML order is intentionally changed.
prototype.reason: The five-pair generic SQLite unchanged CPU minimum exceeds the write floor by 0.399282 seconds, above the allowed 0.15. Stop at this failed first acceptance gate; do not retain the speculative production refactor or claim completion.

retained_reader_probe.method: Five warmed repetitions on the same disposable generic SQLite connection, direct reads versus json_array packing. CPU spans query iteration, decoding and a simplified SHA-256 stream. Hash framing and some float handling differ from production: this is a reader feasibility probe, not an exact row-digest oracle or SQL floor.
